en_title: Forza Horizon 6 Is Finally Coming to PS5 in January Alongside First Expansion
subtitle: 首个扩展同步登场
opus_summary: 《极限竞速：地平线6》将于1月26日登陆PS5，首个大型扩展同日推出，详情尚未公布。预购高级版可提前五天游玩，预购任意版本均可获赠预调校的法拉利J50。

paragraphs.en: Forza Horizon 6 is finally coming to PS5 in January, and it will launch alongside a major expansion to the game.
paragraphs.cn: 《极限竞速：地平线6》终于将在1月登陆PS5，届时还将同步推出一个大型扩展。

paragraphs.en: A new trailer has confirmed that Forza Horizon 6 will race on to PS5 on January 26. It will arrive on the same day and date as the game's first major expansion, though no details have been revealed on what that will look like. As was the case with the Xbox and PC version of the game, players can pre-order the Premium Edition for extra goodies, including five days of early access to the game on PS5. Players who pre-order any version of the game on PS5 will also get a pre-tuned Ferrari J50.
paragraphs.cn: 最新预告片确认，《极限竞速：地平线6》将于1月26日登陆PS5。游戏的首个大型扩展也将于同日推出，不过具体内容尚未公布。与XBOX和PC版一样，玩家可以预购高级版，获得额外奖励，包括提前五天在PS5上游玩。预购PS5版任意版本的玩家还将获得一辆预先调校好的法拉利J50。

paragraphs.en: The news of the game's release date comes after rumors that Forza Horizon 6 would miss its initial 2026 release window for PS5. The news confirms that to be the case, but it will launch just in time to remove itself from GTA 6's blast radius. This should ensure it performs well on PS5 and give the game a healthy audience. Forza Horizon 5 was a massive hit on PS5 when it was released on the console last year, so there is a strong demand for its sequel.
paragraphs.cn: 此前有传闻称，《极限竞速：地平线6》PS5版将无法按原计划在2026年内推出。此次公布的发售日期证实了这一传闻，不过这个档期恰好能让本作避开《GTA6》的冲击。这应该能确保游戏在PS5上取得良好表现，并吸引可观的玩家群体。《极限竞速：地平线5》去年登陆PS5时大获成功，因此玩家对续作的需求也很强烈。

paragraphs.en: IGN gave Forza Horizon 6 a 10/10 in its review , praising it for it dense map, technical achievements, and well-paced campaign.
paragraphs.cn: IGN在评测中为《极限竞速：地平线6》打出了10／10的满分，称赞其内容密集的地图、技术成就，以及节奏得当的生涯模式。

paragraphs.en: "I’ll always concede Forza Horizon 3 may forever be my favourite open-world racer, because who doesn’t love driving around their own backyard, but make no mistake: Forza Horizon 6 is unequivocally the best," reads an excerpt from our review. "The new standard in open-world racing is here, and it’s a gundamn masterpiece."
paragraphs.cn: 我们的评测中写道：「我始终承认，《极限竞速：地平线3》或许永远都是我最喜欢的开放世界竞速游戏，毕竟谁不喜欢在自家后院开车兜风呢？但别误会：《极限竞速：地平线6》毫无疑问是其中最出色的一作。开放世界竞速游戏的新标杆已经到来，这是一部高达级的杰作。」
